falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 low was followed by a grinding recovery without immediate V-shaped reversal above prior resistance; a clean breakout above 5,600 would indicate this is not that pattern but rather a bullish continuation or different structure entirely

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 40 implies elevated stress/uncertainty that should persist near a bottom; rapid VIX compression below 14 would signal fear has fully evacuated and the market has repriced cleanly, invalidating the 'unknown/hold' verdict that assumes unresolved downside risk

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A bottom_2024_aug analog occurred during a specific rates regime where yields were stabilizing/rising from a low base; if yields collapse below 3.80% it signals flight-to-safety or recession pricing inconsistent with the August 2024 macro setup, breaking the pattern match and suggesting a different outcome (deeper bear or policy panic)

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
